sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: NLM MeSH L54 explicitly connects articular extremities of bones, independently giving bone-to-bone key2. «Обычно» keeps the ordinary skeletal-ligament context rather than an exhaustive claim about every named ligament in anatomy (MeSH tree includes broader named structures).11.1 L30 assigns muscle/bone to tendon,9.1 L30/L35 covers cartilage connections, and11.1 L47 covers direct facial muscle/skin attachments; these are real plausible adjacent relations, not additional usual ligament keys. Four short parallel anatomical pairs, no grammatical or format cue.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Связка соединяет кость с костью, связывая суставные концы костей. Сухожилие, напротив, прикрепляет мышцу к кости.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: NLM MeSH L54 supplies the articular bone-end connection in sentence1.11.1 L30 supplies the contrasting tendon muscle-to-bone attachment in sentence2. This explains why the closest tendon alternative is wrong rather than merely naming the key. Russian «суставные концы» follows articular extremities, without calling all cartilage/fibrous articulations movable суставы. Two complete sentences, under70 words.

The note identifies the cartilage materials participating in the own bone/cartilage relationship and uses Russian «соединение», preserving correct scope; it does not assign that relationship to the ligament key.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: NLM MeSH L54 describes flexible fibrous-tissue bands and says they are pliant/tough. «Прочные, гибкие полосы волокнистой ткани» faithfully gives strength, bendability and composition, not an unsupported assertion of stretchiness. These are meaningful own-ligament properties beyond the prompt/key bone-to-bone relation.

absoluteLevel.assessment: The ordinary ligament-versus-tendon attachment distinction is broad adult school/body knowledge: ligament joins bones, tendon attaches muscle. The question requires no specialist classification, rare ligament name or precise material recall. Four real anatomical-pair alternatives remain plausible; a nonexpert must distinguish adjacent structures, without absurd options. Notes contain additional material facts, not prerequisites to solve. This is an independent assessment of47, not an inherited46/author PASS.
